let metric_letters = "KMGTPEZYXWVU"

let words =
    [(spelling = "greatgross", shortest = 7, factor = 1728n),
     (spelling = "googols", shortest = 6, factor = bigint.pow(10n, 100)),
     (spelling = "pairs", shortest = 4, factor = 2n),
     (spelling = "scores", shortest = 3, factor = 20n),

    let limit = if left.length < right.length then left.length
                else right.length fi
    let length mut = 0

    while length < limit /\ left[length] == right[length] do
        length = length + 1
    od

    length

    let product mut = 1n
    let term mut = value

    while term > 0n do
        product = product * term
        term = term - bigint(step)
    od

expand(source: string) -> string is
    let text = source
    let cursor mut = 0
    let negative = text[0] == '-'

    if text[0] == '+' \/ text[0] == '-' then
        cursor = 1
    fi

    let mantissa = LIST[char]()
    let scale mut = 0
    let fractional mut = false

    while cursor < text.length /\
        (char.is_digit(text[cursor]) \/ text[cursor] == ',' \/
         text[cursor] == '.') do
        if text[cursor] == '.' then
            fractional = true
        elif text[cursor] != ',' then
            mantissa.add(text[cursor])

            if fractional then scale = scale + 1 fi
        fi

        cursor = cursor + 1
    od

    if cursor < text.length /\
        (text[cursor] == 'e' \/ text[cursor] == 'E') then
        let marked = cursor + 1
        let signed =
            marked < text.length /\
                (text[marked] == '+' \/ text[marked] == '-')
        let start = if signed then marked + 1 else marked fi
        let stop mut = start

        while stop < text.length /\ char.is_digit(text[stop]) do
            stop = stop + 1
        od

        if stop > start then
            let power = int.parse(text[start..stop])

            scale = scale - (if signed /\ text[marked] == '-' then -power
                             else power fi)

            cursor = stop
        fi
    fi

    let spelt = mantissa |> join("")
    let value mut = if spelt.length == 0 then 0n else bigint.parse(spelt) fi
    let point mut = scale

    if point < 0 then
        value = value * bigint.pow(10n, -point)
        point = 0
    fi

    while cursor < text.length do
        let rest = text[cursor..<0]

        if rest[0] == '!' then
            let marks = rest |> take_while(mark => mark == '!') |> count()
            let unit = bigint.pow(10n, point)

            value = multifactorial(value / unit, marks)
            point = 0
            cursor = cursor + marks
        else
            let lowered = rest.to_lower()
            let named =
                words
                    |> filter(word =>
                        shared_prefix(lowered, word.spelling) >=
                            word.shortest)
                    |> max_by(word =>
                        shared_prefix(lowered, word.spelling))

            if let word = named then
                value = value * word.factor
                cursor =
                    cursor + shared_prefix(lowered, word.spelling)
            else
                let place = metric_letters.index_of(char.to_upper(rest[0]))
                let binary =
                    rest.length > 1 /\ char.to_lower(rest[1]) == 'i'

                if binary then
                    value = value * bigint.pow(2n, (place + 1) * 10)
                    cursor = cursor + 2
                else
                    value = value * bigint.pow(10n, (place + 1) * 3)
                    cursor = cursor + 1
                fi
            fi
        fi
    od

    let unit = bigint.pow(10n, point)
    let whole = value / unit
    let fraction = value % unit
    let head = "{whole:N0}"
    let rendered =
        if fraction =~ 0n then
            head
        else
            "{head}.{"{fraction}".pad_left(point, '0').trim_end('0')}"
        fi

    if negative then "-{rendered}" else rendered fi
